description: This file contains the implementation of the FloatingRatesReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve floating rate data, interest rate periods, and base lending rates from a database, using JdbcTemplate and various RowMappers.

classes.name: FloatingRatesReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the FloatingRatesReadPlatformService interface, providing database access methods for floating rate data.

classes.name: FloatingRateRowMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping ResultSet rows to FloatingRateData objects, with optional inclusion of rate periods.

classes.name: FloatingRatePeriodRowMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping ResultSet rows to FloatingRatePeriodData objects for rate periods.

classes.name: FloatingRateLookupMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping ResultSet rows to minimal FloatingRateData objects used in lookup scenarios.

classes.name: FloatingInterestRatePeriodRowMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping ResultSet rows to InterestRatePeriodData objects, involving joins for linked rate periods.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Fetches all floating rate data records from the database.

methods.name: retrieveAllActive
methods.description: Fetches all active floating rate data records.

methods.name: retrieveLookupActive
methods.description: Fetches a lightweight set of active floating rate data for lookup purposes.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Fetches a single floating rate record by its ID, throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: retrieveInterestRatePeriods
methods.description: Retrieves interest rate periods associated with a specific product ID.

methods.name: retrieveBaseLendingRate
methods.description: Retrieves the base lending rate that is active.
